answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can influence the market, then use randomly assigned, repeated tasks to compare its claims with independently verified outcomes. Agents that coordinate to invent identities cannot multiply their influence for free: each identity ties up capital, and detected collusion forfeits stake and reputation. Random tasks should span a canyon, reef, and summit so scripts tuned to one setting do not pass everywhere; the attacker pays both the cost of many deposits and the risk of losing them.
